name: Hornero Uptime
description: Bar indicator plus popover and dashboard session detail (live uptime and derived boot time) over the shared PluginKit system provider. Zero subprocesses; unavailable state instead of a fabricated zero.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Migrate off cat /proc/uptime subprocess polling to native PluginKit System.uptimeSeconds provider (HorneroOS/plugins#112).
Use Hornero Glyph clock icon in compact/vertical mode and remove duplicate UiTooltip.
Catalogue description no longer leads with an internal version; it says what the extension does first.
Plain wording in footnotes and labels (no internal terms).
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: instrument module header and equal-width readouts; unreadable idle time shows an em dash.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.

Battery & Uptime 2.0 (#31): activation popover and dashboard card with uptime, derived boot time and /proc/uptime idle time, refresh on activation, typed refresh setting (60s 1.x default), host-context layout and Spanish catalog. PluginKit exposes no uptime member, so the declared cat /proc/uptime read is kept.
Bar widget showing system uptime from /proc/uptime every 60 seconds; error state when unreadable.

showLabel.description: Prefix the bar value with 'Up' (the 1.x behaviour); off shows the duration alone.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled unavailable, when uptime is not yet reported; off hides it until a reading arrives.
